scope: Four newly authored source-evaluation tasks using one unmodified official HTTP diagnostic-form template from a different publisher than the preceding MDN cohort; three use unchanged form bytes and one is an explicitly authored control-owner mutation. Every delivery adds an openly authored index.html and scope.css companion to meet the three-file/two-HTML research corpus shape. Not four independent apps, a merchant website, model-training holdout, human usability or representative production accuracy. No runtime or native backend is executed.
referenceMethod: Original source facts, derived mutation and unknown execution boundaries fixed before cycle34 tuning or any provider responses on this cohort. Production intake derives all criterion IDs, titles and exact original source. References remain outside model input. Final implementation/request freeze must be regenerated before first provider I/O.

criteria.title: Original requirement 1
criteria.source: The form source in forms-post.html must include Customer name: and Telephone: and E-mail address: as label text.

reference.rationale: The unchanged native template has three label elements containing Customer name: and Telephone: and E-mail address:. Nested input elements do not remove the surrounding label text. This claims source labels only, not visible rendering or form submission.

criteria.title: Original requirement 2
criteria.source: The static source in forms-post.html must declare custtel as a tel input and custemail as an email input.

reference.rationale: The native custtel control explicitly has type=tel and custemail explicitly has type=email. Bind each name to its own input; no claim that a browser validated either field.

criteria.source: The source content in forms-post.html must pair Small and Medium and Large radio labels with the values small and medium and large under the same size name.

reference.rationale: The Pizza Size fieldset contains the three nested radio labels; their same name=size controls pair Small with small, Medium with medium and Large with large. Values and owners both matter.

criteria.title: Original requirement 2

reference.rationale: The native Pizza Toppings fieldset is unchanged: four checkbox owners under name=topping pair Bacon/bacon, Extra Cheese/cheese, Onion/onion and Mushroom/mushroom. The independent wrong size radio value does not alter this fieldset.

criteria.title: Original requirement 1
criteria.source: Submitting the form must store the customer order in a merchant database and retrieve the same order after a server restart.

reference.rationale: Only template and companion source is supplied. A POST form and Jinja action do not establish a merchant database write, record identity, application restart or independent readback. httpbin is a request/response diagnostic application, not merchant-order acceptance evidence.

criteria.title: Original requirement 2
criteria.source: After the form is submitted a confirmation email must reach the customer external mailbox and the order must be accepted for delivery.

reference.rationale: An email input and Submit order button do not establish a sent email, actual external mailbox receipt or merchant acceptance. No server, browser, mailbox or delivery process was executed in this source assessment.
